future_upload_gate.scope: iOS and iPadOS apps uploaded to App Store Connect
future_upload_gate.unknown_exact_day_handling: Reverify in March and before any April upload; do not infer a day from month-only wording.

code_update_gate.downloaded_feature_changing_code: not permitted by the general rule
code_update_gate.current_app_model: No executable patch engine/provider in application dependency or update source. Android uses Google Play full-build updates, iOS uses signed TestFlight/App Store distribution.
code_update_gate.enablement: held pending exact payload, execution mechanism, signing, review/policy and rollback assessment; no generic OTA approval
